prepare-sales-meeting.userFacingDescription: Prepares a briefing before a customer meeting.
prepare-sales-meeting.agentFacingDescription: Use when preparing a briefing for an upcoming meeting with a prospect or customer.
prepare-sales-meeting.instructions:
# Prepare Sales Meeting

Summarize the account: industry, size, open opportunities and last interactions.

End with three questions to ask during the meeting.

qualify-inbound-lead.agentFacingDescription: Use when deciding whether an inbound lead is worth a sales call.
qualify-inbound-lead.instructions:
# Qualify Inbound Lead

Score the lead on budget, authority, need and timeline, from 1 to 5 each.

Recommend a call when the total is at least 14.

review-pull-request.agentFacingDescription: Use when reviewing a pull request diff for bugs, missing tests and style issues.
review-pull-request.instructions:
# Review Pull Request

List blocking issues first, then suggestions.

Flag any change without a test.

create-support-issue.userFacingDescription: Files support escalations as engineering issues.
create-support-issue.agentFacingDescription: Use when turning a customer support escalation into an engineering issue.
create-support-issue.instructions:
# Create Support Issue

Write a title, the steps to reproduce, the expected and actual behavior, and the affected customer.

Label the issue with its severity: low, medium or high.

write-job-description.userFacingDescription: Writes job descriptions for open roles.
write-job-description.agentFacingDescription: Use when writing the job description of a new open role.
write-job-description.instructions:
# Write Job Description

Cover the mission, the responsibilities, the requirements and the benefits.

Use inclusive language and avoid gendered wording.

onboard-new-hire.userFacingDescription: Builds onboarding plans for new employees.
onboard-new-hire.agentFacingDescription: Use when building the onboarding plan of a new employee.
onboard-new-hire.instructions:
# Onboard New Hire

Plan the first week day by day: accounts, equipment, meetings with the team and the manager.

List the documents the new hire must sign.

answer-policy-question.agentFacingDescription: Use when an employee asks about leave, expenses or remote work policies.
answer-policy-question.instructions:
# Answer Policy Question

Quote the relevant policy section, then answer in plain words.

Say so when the policy does not cover the question.

draft-launch-announcement.agentFacingDescription: Use when drafting the announcement of a product launch for the blog and social media.
draft-launch-announcement.instructions:
# Draft Launch Announcement

Open with the customer problem, then the feature and how to try it.

Write one blog version and one short social media version.
